rule: paired sign test on d = seat-0 Perfection score (candidate - base) per seed, ties dropped: PASS iff the exact one-sided binomial test of P(better) = 0.5 rejects at alpha AND guard (a) the one-sided (1 - alpha) upper bound mean(d) + z * sd(d) / sqrt(N) >= 0 AND guard (b) candidate 10th-percentile score >= base 10th-percentile score (linear-interpolation quantile, Hyndman-Fan type 7)

setup.seatAssignment: opponent list repeated to fill seats 1..players-1, shuffled per seed by a Fisher-Yates permutation from splitmix64(seed ^ SEAT_STREAM); identical for candidate and base

signTest.test: exact one-sided binomial, H0 P(better) = 0.5, ties dropped
